title: Time Tuple Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: The eight fields of time.localtime() as labeled boxes filled from your clock: click for an index, drag for a slice like now[3:6], or quiz yourself on the field order.

learningObjectives: Identify the name, index and range of each of the eight time tuple fields
Apply indexing such as now[3] to extract one field
Apply slicing such as now[3:6] to extract several fields and unpack them

accessibility.notes: Controls are standard HTML form elements; the canvas has a describe() text for screen readers

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive labeled data structure with retrieval quiz
keyQuestions: Why does now[3:6] return three values and not four?
commonMisconceptions: Months are numbered from 0 like list positions
assessmentOpportunities: Students give the index of any field from memory.
Students write the slice that returns (month, day).
Students explain that the stop index is not included in a slice.

controls.label: Live clock
controls.description: Updates the values every second (off at load)

controls.label: Quiz me
controls.description: Hides field names and asks for a field

controls.label: Boxes
controls.description: Click for one field, drag across boxes for a slice
